prompt: Original generic modular vegetation; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. shore grass clumps; region/species assumption, visual review required; use proper silhouette and leaf geometry, not low-quality filler Target bounding dimensions 1.2m wide x 0.22m high x 1.2m deep. Materials: leaf-neutral. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
